<description>
Just ran `guix-codesign` for v32.0 as root, in fanquake's container image ([option 3](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/master/contrib/guix/INSTALL.md#option-3-using-fanquakes-container-image) in INSTALL.md) and got this error while unpacking the codesigning tarball:

```bash
tar: ./detached-sig-create.sh: Cannot change ownership to uid 0, gid 0: Invalid argument
tar: ./unsigned/bitcoin-32.0: Cannot change ownership to uid 0, gid 0: Invalid argument
tar: ./unsigned/bitcoin-32.0-win64-setup-unsigned.exe: Cannot change ownership to uid 0, gid 0: Invalid argument
...
tar: Exiting with failure status due to previous errors
```
Same happens for the macOS files.

When updating guix in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/34550, `--no-same-owner` was added in `build.sh` (now in `setup.sh`) in 0f323e10759aba4429677d0e1e202bf575b6d664, but not in `codesign.sh`. This PR adds it to `TAR_OPTIONS` in `codesign.sh`. This fixed the issue for me and my hashes match the other attestations for v32.0.
</description>
